summary: Algorhythm Holdings filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose it regained compliance with Nasdaq's $2.5M stockholders' equity continued-listing requirement after reporting $3.168M equity as of March 31, 2026. Compliance was achieved by reducing expenses, increasing net sales via its SemiCab business, and selling common stock to Streeterville Capital. The Nasdaq granted an extension and will monitor future compliance; failure at the next periodic report could trigger delisting. The filing is a routine compliance update, not a special situation event.
